key_insight: The paper argues that AI safety needs new mathematics across several fields to make systems legible, steerable, and cooperative with humans.
engineering_relevance: For AI and ML engineering, it highlights where foundational math can support safer training, better interpretability, and more controllable model behavior.
method: Uses a field-by-field roadmap for mathematicians entering AI safety
Connects logic and game theory to cooperation
Links probability, algebra, representation theory, analysis, and geometry to agency, features, generalization, and training dynamics
evidence_signal: The abstract is a conceptual survey rather than a data-driven study; its support comes from organizing open problems by mathematical discipline.
watch_item: The proposal is broad and invitation-oriented, so practical impact depends on translating abstract problems into testable AI safety methods and benchmarks.
paper_title: Math for AI safety: an invitation for mathematicians
